what: Lists the Town's financial management policies as adopted by the Board of Selectmen in July 2004.

Approves the OPEB funding policy as amended, subject to the Finance Committee: at least 10% of certified free cash to the trust each year.

board: Finance Committee and Board of Selectmen
what: Roads come off the free cash priority list, as paving had moved into the operating budget; the OPEB share takes their place. No minutes are held.
Introduces the draft financial policies written by the Division of Local Services under a Community Compact grant. No action is taken.

who: a resident and the Town Manager
what: A resident questions adding to reserves while schools face cuts. The Town Manager says funding operations from free cash is contrary to Town policy and state guidance.
Says local receipts have not come in under $4 million in ten years. A larger reserve fund is also raised, in captions only.
Proposes a goal of adopting four policies by December: OPEB, stabilization and reserves, free cash, and revenue projections.
In public comment, calls the capital planning process unwieldy and undemocratic.
